ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with an estimated 65% high-intensity (white) pixels to 35% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central-to-distal portions of both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and central notch, with dense irregular mottling throughout the white areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude serrations and several distinct deeper notches across the entire boundary, isolated against the grey sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the main trailing edge transitioning into tapered, upwardly swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity, circular pixel clusters (barnacles) located at both distal tips; sparse individual circular spots detected within the dark central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, elongated linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the white regions of both lobes, particularly visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the tips; multiple irregular notches along the trailing edge suggesting historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern with high asymmetry between the left and right lobes.
